name: pixelfx
description: pixelfx by Patch, wrapped by FrameCore Works: 244 pixel art effects as code (fire, explosions, magic, hits, UI, transitions) acted out with wind-up, hit-stop and recovery, sprite sheets for any engine, and the draft, render, look, refine method for new ones. Checkout pinned to the reviewed commit.

interface.longDescription: Pixel art effects and sprite animations with pixelfx by Patch (MIT): 244 ready effects to recolor, export as sprite sheets or GIF/MP4, and a draft, render, look, refine loop for new ones. Downloads the pixelfx repository at the reviewed commit into the project after your yes; needs git and Node.js 18+, ffmpeg optional.
